item.description:
Dax 3.8.5

  • Browser agents can now fill Dax’s HTTP sign-in card using the same snapshot, type, click and keyboard tools they use on a page. You see the cursor move, the field light up and the characters arrive. Passwords stay masked and are never echoed in tool replies.
  • Sign-in cards report rejected credentials, prevent partial passwords from being submitted while typing, and close when their page is stopped, replaced or closed.
  • Waiting agents show a pulsing orange dot in the sidebar, aligned with the green running dots. Shared folder and collapsed-strip dots pulse too, including when an existing dot changes state.
  • The new drawer_send_to_phone tool sends files or folders to your paired phone from file paths or File Drawer entries. Folders are zipped; each file may be up to 95 MB, with up to 20 inputs per request.
  • Phone sends report acceptance by the Link, a pending retry, or the reason a file could not be sent. They use the existing outbox and can keep retrying for seven days. A phone must be paired.

Automatic updates introduced in 3.8 remain enabled by default and respect your setting. If you are on Dax 3.3 or earlier, install this release once to move to the current app while keeping your saved work.
